editorial:
Imagine your heart just got crushed and your best friend decides the only cure is a wild weekend of bad decisions. That is exactly what happens to Spencer, a total romantic who cannot stop dreaming of true love. His buddy thinks he is being too soft and puts together a mantervention. The goal is simple: turn Spencer into a cold-hearted player who doesn't care about feelings. The vibe is light, loud, and full of the kind of chaos you expect from a group of guys trying to be cool while actually having no clue what they are doing.

You will probably love the chemistry between the leads because their friendship feels real, even when they are doing ridiculous things. While the plot is a bit predictable, the fast pacing keeps you from getting bored. Some of the jokes might feel a bit dated, but it is still a fun ride.
endingExplained: After spending the weekend trying to be a player, Spencer realizes that acting like a jerk is not for him. He discovers that his friend was actually projecting his own fears of commitment. In the final scenes, Spencer chooses to embrace his romantic side instead of hiding it. He ends up chasing after the girl he actually likes, proving that being vulnerable is better than being a player. Everything wraps up with a happy, feel-good ending.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy comedies about friendship and dating.
